Name: (CP) PokeMonsters
Author: Zaffre7
Description:
[i]Mod is a very heavy Work in Progress- I'd been wanting to make this for a while already, and figured now would be a good time to at least post what I have at the moment. It might be a bit before an update, as life is Crazy right now, but I do plan on coming back to it! ^^[/i]

Replaces the Monsters of the game with Pokemon in their place.

[b][u]Install Instructions:[/u][/b]
1. Download the zip
2. Extract into Mods folder
3. Play!


[b][u]Currently Contains:[/u][/b]
Grub (Normal) -> Caterpie / Metapod
Fly (Normal) -> Butterfree


[b][u]Plans:[/u][/b]
Grub (Dangerous) -> Weedle / Kakuna
Fly (Dangerous) -> Beedrill


Feel free to send suggestions!
Thank you!
